title: When the Colony Breaks Again
author: Ulyana Halloran
blurb: Ivo Voss, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
